main_text.p: confequens contingens. Et hanc effe Schola-fticorum fententiam unanimem, docet ipfe Je-Valent in q. 22. Aq. p. 339.fuita Gregor. de Valent. Communiter (inquit) theologi dicunt effectum contingentem, qua-tenus eft quidem a Deo provifus, effe inevitabi-bilem (feu neceffarium fecundum quid, nimi-mirum ex ea hypothefi divinae providentiae. Simpliciter autem & abfolute evitabilem propter conditionem nimirum proximae caufae il-Cajet. 1 par. q.22. art.4.lius, quae eft contingens. Et Cajetanus, Omnes (inquit) Doctores affirmant hoc. Idem doceri a Trigofio docet Guil, Tuiffus in fcho-Trigof. com: [illegible, ~2 letters] fumma thea.lasticorum scriptis vir non mediocriter verfatus. Braduard, Illum (inquit) pro Deo no-Bonav. 1.p. q.15.ar.2.ftro nolo habere, qui non fit omnipotens in agendo, qui non habeat omnipotentiffimum dominatum supra meam debilem voluntatem, qui non poffet omnipotentiffime facere me velle; & facere quicquid vellet, qui non habeat voluntemGvil. Tuiff. in vindic. sent. universaliter efficacem, infrustrabilem, indefectibilem & necessariam inArm. l.2. crim.3 q.5. causando; imo cujus voluntas, non fit mihi neceffitas, cujus fanctiffimam voluntatem ego peccator, velut mulierculam debilem facillime poffum opprimere & neceffitare ad horribilem actum peccati, &c. Haec eadem citatf. 17. Bred. de [illegible, ~3 letters] Dei.3. c. 29. & Tuiffius. Scotus, Contra (inquit) naturamScot in 4. q.49. q.6. voluntatis eft determinari a caufa inferiori quia hoc ipfo non effet fuperior, non eft autem contra eam determinari a caufa fuperiore. Id docent Capreolus, & Ferrariensis. Alvarez de auxil.Capreol. l.2. q.38. q.1. ar. d, 22. Probat quod Deus absoluto decreto,

page.notes: Left margin citations are read from a small, uneven print and some abbreviations are doubtful; the marginal entry after "Trigof. com:" and the one after "Bred. de" could not be read in full. The catchword "vere" stands alone below the last line. The text "voluntem" is printed that way and may be a misprint for "voluntatem". "Guil" in the text is doubtful.
